about-main.title: About our philosophy...
about-main.content: We strive to be 100% transparent! We want to build/improve Internet services, generally remaining Free & Open-Source.

about-main2.title: Innovation & Accessibility
about-main2.content: We also design free and open-source software, while offering paid and advanced solutions. Part of this income is used to finance our projects and support our solidarity actions.
